correctness.rationale: Exact ten-element base-class enumeration from the edge-index spacing condition; static dimension two by one shattered pair plus ten exhaustive absent-trace certificates; adaptive dimension three by eight complete root-to-leaf witnesses and the 10<16 size bound. The elementary, proved VC/Littlestone Cartesian-product additivity lemma yields the exact all-s dimensions. Paths with at most six edges have matching rank at most three, and rank-three classes have only one or four hypotheses. Source files RESULT.md, verify_uniform_matchings.py and verification_output.txt contain complete reproductions; no infinite conclusion is inferred from finite tests.

value.rationale: The quota-constrained path matching incidence system is a graph-theoretically natural, fully specified family, and the smallest full-depth-three matching gadget exhibits an exact adaptive-vs-static separation with explicit positive and negative certificates. Component quotas replicate this structural obstruction into an unbounded additive difference Ldim-VCdim=s for a bounded-component-degree-two forest, despite a fixed matching cardinality in each component. This is a motivated sharp first-boundary example rather than a free renaming or a random small set system; it does not claim broad classification.
